description: Platform transparency records for the Osint pack's optional platform-transparency features (#2580): EU DSA Transparency Database statements of reasons, Meta Ad Library and Google political ads, and Lumen takedown notices under researcher access. Records as published with source, record revision and as-of time; spend and impression ranges never converted to point estimates. Audit: docs/development/platform-transparency-evidence/source-audit.md. Every source is unverified-live until a dated run; Lumen is gated (researcher access not granted).

sources.update_cadence: on explicit selection only; nothing is polled in the background
sources.scope: declared (platform, day) light daily dumps of Article 24(5) DSA statements of reasons; rows of other platforms are never stored; free text, content ids and notifier identity dropped (SP01)

license.redistribution: Commission reuse policy, CC BY 4.0 with attribution to the DSA Transparency Database (operator must verify the database terms)

sources.temporal_semantics: application date and creation time of each statement as published; the dump day and file digest are the dump version; a republished dump is a new revision

sources.update_cadence: on explicit selection only; nothing is polled in the background
sources.scope: political and issue ads of declared pages, reached countries and delivery windows; advertiser, funding entity (bylines), delivery times, spend and impression ranges and currency as published; creative text and audience distributions dropped (SP01)

license.redistribution: research and transparency use under the Meta Platform Terms; no sale, advertising use or profiling; cite the Ad Library (operator must verify)

sources.temporal_semantics: delivery start and stop times as published; each acquisition is an observation and a changed or no-longer-returned ad is a new revision

platform_transparency.coverage_decision: three synthetic pages (organisation, action fund, person-named page) in two countries

sources.update_cadence: on explicit selection only; nothing is polled in the background
sources.scope: advertiser and creative statistics of the declared advertiser ids from the political ads bundle; spend ranges and impression buckets exactly as published; the bundle refresh time on every record; other advertisers never stored

license.redistribution: reuse with attribution to the Google Political Advertising Transparency Report (operator must verify)

sources.temporal_semantics: date ranges and served timestamps as published; the bundle's data refresh time is the source as-of time; a changed or no-longer-listed ad is a new revision

platform_transparency.coverage_decision: four synthetic advertiser ids (one absent from the bundle) and two election-label mappings

sources.update_cadence: on explicit selection only; nothing is polled in the background
sources.publisher: Lumen (Berkman Klein Center for Internet & Society)
sources.scope: takedown notices for one declared recipient platform and window under researcher access; metadata permitted by the access terms with Lumen's redactions preserved; notice bodies, works and URLs never stored

license.redistribution: researcher access only; notice metadata as permitted, no republication of notice bodies or URLs (operator must verify the granted terms)

sources.temporal_semantics: date sent and date received as published; a changed or no-longer-returned notice is a new revision

platform_transparency.coverage_decision: one synthetic recipient platform for one month; researcher access not granted to this deployment
